title: Israeli forces fired shots at Gaza aid flotilla vessels, video shows
desc: Israeli forces opened fire on at least two vessels in an aid flotilla sailing towards Gaza on Tuesday, according to video footage and flotilla organizers. But Israel said no live ammunition was used and there were no casualties.
